title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates
content:
## Introduction to Pregnancy Nutrition
Pregnancy nutrition is a crucial aspect of the pregnancy process. Expectant mothers need to ensure they are providing adequate nutrition for both themselves and their baby. In this article, we will introduce international pantry staples that are good for pregnancy.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy
The following international pantry staples are good options for pregnant women:
- Oats: rich in fiber, which helps support digestive health and reduce the risk of constipation.
- Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, which helps support the development of bones and teeth for the baby.
- Lentils: rich in iron, which helps support the production of blood for both mother and baby.
- Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3 fatty acids, which helps support the development of the baby's brain and eyes.
- Eggs: rich in protein, which helps support the development of muscles and tissues for the baby.
- Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamins and minerals, which helps support the immune system and reduce the risk of disease.

## Building Balanced Plates for Pregnancy
To build a balanced plate for pregnancy, expectant mothers can combine these international pantry staples with local ingredients. For example:
- Breakfast: oats with Greek yogurt and fruit.
- Lunch: lentils with leafy greens and low-mercury salmon.
- Dinner: eggs with leafy greens and citrus.

## Food Safety Considerations
Expectant mothers need to consider food safety when preparing and consuming international pantry staples. Some important considerations include:
- Cooking food before consumption.
- Avoiding raw or undercooked food.
- Washing hands and utensils before preparing food.
- Storing food properly to avoid contamination.

## Conclusion
International pantry staples can be a great addition to a pregnant woman's diet. However, expectant mothers need to consider food safety and combine these staples with local ingredients to build a balanced plate. For more information on pregnancy nutrition and recipes, please visit [our website](/planner).
